$comment: JSON Schema for the daily OpenFunds Dynamic Data file (au60etl93373_openfunds_daily_latest.json).
title: AU60ETL93373 OpenFunds Daily Summary
description: JSON Schema for au60etl93373_openfunds_daily_latest.json, the two OpenFunds Dynamic Data fields that change with every new valuation date (AuM Share Class, NoS Share Class) for the FT Capital Multi Class Investment Fund US Large Cap Enhanced Complex Class (ISIN AU60ETL93373, APIR ETL9337AU), keyed by real OpenFunds OF-ID (https://openfunds.org). Kept separate from the static au60etl93373_openfunds_latest.json file, whose fields do not change daily.

fund.const: FT Capital Multi Class Investment Fund

class.const: US Large Cap Enhanced Complex Class

standard_version.description: The OpenFunds catalog version the OF-IDs below are checked against, e.g. 2.13.0.

OFDY000070.description: AuM Share Class -- Assets under Management of the share class, in the fund's reporting currency.

OFDY000071.description: AuM Share Class Date -- the valuation date the AuM figure applies to.

OFDY000075.description: NoS Share Class -- total shares/units outstanding for this share class.

OFDY000076.description: NoS Share Class Date -- the valuation date the NoS figure applies to.
